name: fossa-pr
description: FOSSA issues on a GitHub pull request: list them, tell new from old, then explain, fix, ignore, or request a fossabot upgrade PR for eligible dependency vulnerabilities.

interface.shortDescription: Triage the FOSSA issues on a pull request
interface.longDescription: Lists the FOSSA issues on a GitHub pull request, marks the ones the PR brought in, and fixes or ignores each one, or requests a fossabot upgrade PR for eligible dependency vulnerabilities. Runs a small local MCP server that uses your FOSSA API key and your gh login.
defaultPrompt: Show the FOSSA issues on this PR
